description: This file contains implementation code for Bluetooth module setup and communication, including command sequences, thread management, and configuration for different Bluetooth modules.

methods.name: runCommands
methods.description: Executes a sequence of Bluetooth commands, managing baud rate changes and response handling.

methods.name: btThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry function that manages Bluetooth setup procedure, including user prompts and command execution.

methods.name: bluetoothStart
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth module with specified parameters and starts the setup thread.

methods.name: bluetoothSoftwareDisconnectNotify
methods.description: Notifies the system that Bluetooth software disconnect has occurred, resuming setup thread.

methods.name: bluetoothCancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing Bluetooth setup procedure and terminates related thread.
